digest.component_or_area: LLM gate economics and cost optimization
propositions: Mean LLM gate costs measured: plan-review $3.02/run, code-review $1.42/run, completion-verifier $2.24/run, averaging $11.85/completed ticket; cheap-model experiments rejected Haiku for agentic review but identified Nova Pro and bounded pilots as credible levers.

Code-review severity axes are inert because routing disables blocking on 98.2% of findings and the 0.95 decision threshold is structurally unreachable (0 of 3,738 graded findings achieved the required 3-way AND on blast_radius=system AND likelihood=high AND reversibility=hard), not because the reviewer finds little or under-reports.

A phased ordinal-to-binary migration plan for gate decisions was developed and requires operator approval before execution; Phase 0-2 address plan-review, Phase 3 addresses code-review using a 3,230-finding verification corpus.

Deprecation removal audit found only 1 of 9 candidates ready to remove now (the retired .gitattributes migration arm); single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are candidates for a new pre-1.0 breaking window but require scheduling decisions.

AWS alarm sweep identified 2 true-positive review-interrupt bound-exceeded firings suggesting DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX is undersized and 2 false-positive firings caused by over-broad grep patterns in observability.sh metric emission, with 2 new defects filed and a bridge/reconcile alarm coverage gap flagged.
